//: ABS validation scenario.  Drive to 30 m/s, then slam the brakes.
//1: Same scenario file used for both BTCM-on and BTCM-off comparison runs;
//2: the difference is whether the BTCM controller is spawned alongside
//3: ev1sim.  See scripts/run_abs_compare.sh for the orchestrator.
//5: Per-wheel slip + omega columns are the headline diagnostic — watch
//6: the four wheels during the brake event.  With ABS engaged you should
//7: see slip held below ~0.15 across all four; without ABS the wheels
//10: Stopping distance: integrate sqrt((pos_x - x0)^2 + (pos_y - y0)^2)
//11: from brake-on to speed=0.  scripts/compare_abs_runs.py does this.
name: abs_hard_brake

events.//: Ease onto the pedal over ~0.75 s (not a step to full throttle —
events.//1: that spins the drive wheels from a dead stop; see the PR
events.//2: description for the measured before/after) until ~30 m/s,

events.//: Coast to settle dynamics, then SLAM the brake to 100 %.  Hard
events.//1: enough that without ABS modulation the wheels lock up.
events.//2: This comment used to say "brief coast to settle" above a 7.00 s
events.//3: brake, and there was no coast at all: wait_for_speed is a barrier
events.//4: that does not advance the event index (src/Scenario.cpp), so a
events.//5: brake scheduled behind it fires on the RELEASE tick — measured
events.//7: tick the throttle dropped to zero.  18.00 s makes the settle real:
events.//8: 2.97 s of coast.  Brake value (1.0) and hold duration (18.0 s)
events.//9: are UNCHANGED; only the schedule moved.

events.//: Hold full brake until vehicle stops or scenario ends.
